description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the acquisitions under Metro Colombo Urban Development Project in Mahawatta, Colombo D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing compensation payments for various land parcels acquired by the government. It provides schedules with specific land details (location, assessment numbers, lot numbers, extents) and deposited compensation amounts, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category for land and property-related administrative matters.
